evidence.ACL: Flat slope of ACL, C/W tear.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of lateral meniscus, with small size of posterior horn and displaced fragment, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular carilage over lateral apsect of femorotibial joint with subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
